ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible surface; high-intensity pixels are almost exclusively localized to water spray and specular highlights rather than skin pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 50 degrees; partially obscured by water turbulence at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude saw-tooth serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature observed from the median notch extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, irregular white/beige clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with heavy barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the terminal ends of the fluke lobes, significantly altering the smooth geometric profile of the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel-level noise across the fluke surface caused by high-intensity specular highlights from water droplets.
